environment.description: EKS cluster (v1.28) with Istio 1.20 service mesh. Pod has istio-proxy sidecar injected (strict mode). The mesh-level PeerAuthentication resource for namespace 'monitoring' sets mtls.mode=STRICT. An Istio AuthorizationPolicy restricts access to port 8080 to principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/internal-tools/sa/dashboard-aggregator' only. External traffic enters via an AWS ALB Ingress with annotation 'alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-type: cognito' but the /debug/* path is NOT exposed in the Ingress resource's path rules — only /healthz is routed. The pod's port 8080 is additionally covered by a Cilium NetworkPolicy that drops all ingress from sources outside CIDR 10.0.0.0/8. The combination means: (1) no external route exists to /debug/status through the ALB, (2) mesh-internal access requires a valid SPIFFE identity from a specific service account, and (3) L3/L4 policy blocks non-cluster traffic even if mesh is bypassed.

config.cilium_network_policy: CiliumNetworkPolicy{endpointSelector: {matchLabels: {app: status-service}}, ingress: [{fromCIDR: ['10.0.0.0/8'], toPorts: [{ports: [{port: '8080', protocol: TCP}]}]}]}
